facts.text: HardwareController is the low-level serial communication class for the Opentrons hardware
The lid set command is M140 and the plate set command is M104
The lid read command is M141 and the plate read command is M105
deactivate_all is M18 and the shake set command is M3
open_lid is M126 and close_lid is M127
Each command is framed by CRLF on both sides
The controller opens the serial port at 115200 baud with 2 s read and write timeouts
get_lid_temperature sends the lid read command and parses the C: field after a T line
get_plate_info sends the plate read command and parses the C: temperature and H: seconds from a T line
get_plate_info returns the plate temperature and the seconds left as a two-element list
set_lid_temperature appends S and the target to the lid set command
set_plate_temperature appends S target and optional H duration and V well volume to the plate set command
set_shake_speed appends S and the target to the shake command
deactivate_all sends the deactivate-all command
deactivate_shaker sends the deactivate-shake and deactivate-heating commands
The controller returns False instead of raising when the serial port cannot be opened
The GUI emergency stop calls deactivate_all
The HelixShaker deactivate-all button calls deactivate_shaker
The lid target temperature entry accepts 37 to 105 Cel
The plate target temperature entry accepts 4 to 99 Cel
The lid heats passively and cools ambiently; it has no active cooling
Deactivate all stops heating and cooling for both the lid and the plate
The actual lid and plate temperatures are updated automatically every few seconds while idle
A STEP hold time is in seconds and a blank hold time means an infinite hold

operator_required.name: shake_speed
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a shake speed range: the README documents the shaker control but gives no minimum or maximum RPM, and the controller sends M3 S<target> without a readback (tc_send_code.py:152-153). The site supplies the range of its unit
